_provenance.rule: Every value here carries the PDF page it was read from. A value that is not stated in the wording is null with a reason. Nothing is inferred from another product.
_provenance.page_numbering: pdf_page is the 1-based PDF index. printed_page is what the footer of that page shows, which is what the agent sees.
_provenance.NOT_IN_WORDINGS: Premium and entry-age limits do not appear in most policy wordings. When absent from the wording, they are null with a reason.
